basic_profile.headline: Chief Security Officer | Ex-Superintendent of Police | Expert in Risk, Fraud Prevention & Supply Chain Security | Board-Certified Director
basic_profile.summary:
I am a forward-thinking security and risk management leader with 30+ years of experience spanning law enforcement, corporate security, logistics, and technology-led risk prevention. Currently serving as Chief Security Officer at Delhivery, I design and oversee security, trust, and safety frameworks across India’s largest logistics network — covering 24 automated sort centers, 90+ fulfilment hubs, 2,500+ delivery centers, and 58,000+ employees.

Previously, as a Superintendent of Police in Pondicherry, I specialized in trafficking, narcotics enforcement, cybercrime, and community policing, achieving a 99% conviction rate and pioneering India’s early cybercrime investigations.

I’ve driven business continuity, fraud prevention, safety, and compliance strategies for Fortune 500s, airports, defense, banking, and e-commerce. My leadership philosophy is built on change management, operational excellence, and digital transformation — blending public service discipline with corporate agility.

Recognized with awards including the Golden Peacock Award, SECONA Shield for Security Project of the Year, and Assocham SME Excellence Award, I also hold patents and publications on e-governance, fraud detection, and women’s safety tech solutions.

Specialties: Corporate Security, Supply Chain Risk, Fraud Analytics, Business Continuity, Regulatory Compliance, Project Management, Independent Directorship

past.employer_linkedin_description: he Government of India, officially known as the Union Government, and also known as the Central Government, was established by the Constitution of India, and is the governing authority of a union of 28 states and seven union territories, collectively called the Republic of India. It is seated in New Delhi, the capital of India.The government comprises three branches: the executive, the legislative and the judiciary. The executive branch headed by the President, who is the Head of State and exercises his or her power directly or through officers subordinate to him.[1] The Legislative branch or the Parliament consists of the lower house, the Lok Sabha, and the upper house, the Rajya Sabha, as well as the president. The Judicial branch has the Supreme Court at its apex, 21 High Courts, and numerous civil, criminal and family courts at the district level.The basic civil and criminal laws governing the citizens of India are set down in major parliamentary legislation, such as the Civil Procedure Code, the Indian Penal Code, and the Criminal Procedure Code. The union and individual state governments consist of executive, legislative and judicial branches. The legal system as applicable to the federal and individual state governments is based on the English Common and Statutory Law. India accepts International Court of Justice jurisdiction with several reservations.

basic_profile.summary:
I am a forward-thinking security and risk management leader with 30+ years of experience spanning law enforcement, corporate security, logistics, and technology-led risk prevention. Currently serving as Chief Security Officer at Delhivery, I design and oversee security, trust, and safety frameworks across India’s largest logistics network — covering 24 automated sort centers, 90+ fulfilment hubs, 2,500+ delivery centers, and 58,000+ employees.

Previously, as a Superintendent of Police in Pondicherry, I specialized in trafficking, narcotics enforcement, cybercrime, and community policing, achieving a 99% conviction rate and pioneering India’s early cybercrime investigations.

I’ve driven business continuity, fraud prevention, safety, and compliance strategies for Fortune 500s, airports, defense, banking, and e-commerce. My leadership philosophy is built on change management, operational excellence, and digital transformation — blending public service discipline with corporate agility.

Recognized with awards including the Golden Peacock Award, SECONA Shield for Security Project of the Year, and Assocham SME Excellence Award, I also hold patents and publications on e-governance, fraud detection, and women’s safety tech solutions.

Specialties: Corporate Security, Supply Chain Risk, Fraud Analytics, Business Continuity, Regulatory Compliance, Project Management, Independent Directorship

He headed e-commerce operations for Paytm (largest payments player in India) and led customer acquisition for the payments bank and built B2B business for Paytm merchants from scratch. He is now heading the payments business for over 20M+ merchants at Paytm. 

A very quick learner and proven ability to work in an ambiguous environment and helping provide dynamic leadership to the organisation. basic_profile.name: Vidya Bhushan
basic_profile.headline: AI/ML Product Leader | IIT KGP | IIM A | SST | Built & Scaled India’s Largest Smart Vending Network
basic_profile.summary:
I’m a product and strategy leader with 14+ years of experience scaling AI-first digital platforms across consumer tech, fintech, and enterprise SaaS.

As the Co-founder of Daalchini Technologies, I led the company from inception to becoming India’s largest AI-powered smart vending network, with 2,500+ IoT-enabled kiosks across 78 cities and 21 states, processing over 100,000 transactions per day. We pioneered out-of-home (OOH) Q-commerce and contactless retail—building a tech platform that merged real-time analytics, AI/ML-driven inventory optimization, and IoT-based automation.

Before Daalchini, I was part of the national launch team at Jio and led fintech innovations at Paytm and Paysafe, building scale-first mobile products that served millions.

I bring a rare blend of deep technical fluency, platform-thinking, and P&L ownership—having built cross-functional teams, raised $9M+ in venture funding, and steered operations to profitability.

🎓 I hold a B.Tech from IIT Kharagpur (DAAD Scholar, YAAA Awardee) and an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. My research in AI-driven decision-making using EEG and neural networks was published in PLOS ONE and informs my passion for applied AI in real-world systems.

I’m now focused on driving product leadership in GenAI, enterprise SaaS, and telecom-AI intersections, and open to advisory and leadership roles that seek to blend AI innovation with business scale.

Two PIC18F2331  microcontrollers were used for controlling two D.C. Servo Motors with incremental encoder feedback. This robot had an LCD Display, Battery Source, Ethernet Interface to Computer from main microcontroller card and Remote  Monitoring.

Shiprocket is India’s largest eCommerce enablement platform providing digital retailers an end-to-end customer experience platform. The platform which is creating an operating system for direct commerce enables shipping, fulfillment, customer communication and marketing tools as well as providers for SMEs, D2C retailers, and social commerce retailers in India. With 25+ courier partners on board, the brand enables pan-India as well as international shipping deliveries. Its shipping solutions are available across 24,000+ pin codes within India and 220 countries worldwide.Launched in 2017, Shiprocket is on a mission to create a seamless logistics data platform that connects retailers, carriers, and consumers across national and international locations. Shiprocket provides a technology stack to help retailers integrate their shopping websites on Shopify, Magento, Woocommerce, Zoho, or others with the platform’s multi-carrier API to manage orders, print shipping labels, and avail tracking information from multiple providers including managing Cash on Delivery (COD) orders and payment reconciliation. Shiprocket also offers state-of-the-art fulfillment solutions with more than 35+ warehouses located across India. The technology stack provides a robust post-purchase experience to consumers, resulting in higher engagement and lower RTO (failed deliveries).Today, Shiprocket is the platform behind 2.5 lakh plus sellers who generate a GMV of more than $2.5B annually. The platform delivers packets to more than 70M consumers annually and is growing transactions 2.5-3X year on year.

basic_profile.headline: Building Profitable Logistics Systems | Pricing, P&L & Network Strategy | LTL, 3PL, Cost Transformation | Ex-Merchant Navy
basic_profile.summary: I build profitable logistics businesses by fixing pricing, cost structures, and network design at scale. Over 20 years, I’ve moved from global shipping operations to strategy consulting to full P&L ownership in India’s logistics sector. This progression has given me a rare combination of execution depth, analytical rigor, and business leadership. At Delhivery, I lead pricing and profitability for the LTL business, driving structural margin improvement, building pricing systems, and enabling disciplined growth. At Spoton, I expanded from network optimization into enterprise-wide cost transformation, including automation and AI-led decision systems. My work consistently focuses on one outcome: converting complex, inefficient operations into predictable, scalable, and profitable systems. Core areas of strength:- Pricing architecture and margin management - P&L ownership and EBITDA improvement - Network design and cost optimization - Automation, AI, and decision systems in logistics - Cross-functional leadership across ops, finance, and product  I am now focused on roles with end-to-end business ownership, where I can drive transformation, build teams, and scale profitable growth.

past.employer_name: Sical Logistics Ltd., Cafe Coffee Day Company
past.employer_linkedin_description: Sical Logistics Ltd., founded in 1955 and with revenues in excess of Rs. 800 Cr., is India’s leading integrated logistics solutions provider with over 5 decades of experience in providing end to end logistics solutions. In 2011 Sical was acquired by the Rs. 4000 Cr. Coffee Day group, one of India’s fastest growing business conglomerates with interests ranging from coffee plantations and agri-businesses, commodity exports, stakeholdings in leading IT and embedded technology companies, real estate and hospitality.While traditionally known for its stevedoring, customs handling, trucking and steamer agency businesses, Sical today has made significant investments in logistics related infrastructure and operates mechanized Port terminals (container and bulk), container freight stations, container rakes, rail and road terminals. In addition to above Sical also provides offshore support services to the oil and gas industry and owns and operates a 2006 built cutter suction dredger.At Sical every aspect of logistics namely port handling, road and rail transport, warehousing, shipping etc.  are  combined as an integrated logistics solutions and tailored to meet individual client needs.This is aided by investments in state of the art Infrastructure, equipments and handling facilities to provide Cargo handling efficiency. Sical also offers comprehensive custom made yet cost effective solutions depending on specific needs enhancing flexibility, safety and reliability norms.Handling more than 26 million tons of bulk and over 0.5 million TEUS of container cargo annually Sical is one of the few ‘Made in India’ organizations with a strong network having independent operations countrywide. The success mantra is based on creating right process, investing in right infrastructure, recruiting and nourishing capability of employees, constant training and exemplary business ethics.

Vision 1. Using technology to improve healthcare access2. Make healthcare affordable to ensure universal reach3. Create a system of continuous improvement by fostering a 360 degree cycle of data collection, intervention and feedback.Set up in 2010, Glocal is a bold attempt to redefine healthcare. It focuses on understanding the problems of healthcare, designs solutions & implements them. It is an integrated healthcare player from primary, secondary to tertiary healthcare; from brick & mortar to virtual; from skills to technology to infra to delivery – Glocal does it all.Glocal currently runs as many as ten hospitals across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Odisha, bringing state-of-the-art medical facilities, infrastructure along with technology and skills closer to the under-served India.The hospitals run on a process based & outcome oriented system, providing outstanding medical services at a price point that provides maximum access to the intended audience. Apart from Hospitals, Glocal Healthcare has come up with Digital Dispensaries in a bid to solve the problem of primary healthcare in underserved regions of India. Capable of running a hospital sans surgery, Digital Dispensary is a wonder in itself.A Digital Dispensary or a hospital in a box is an innovative brick and mortar centre which aims at providing complete primary and emergency healthcare solution such as consultation, confirmatory tests, and medicines from a single point. It is a path-breaking innovation which lets us parade into the world of tomorrow. So far Glocal has been operating more than 130 Digital dispensaries in Rajasthan, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Manipur and West Bengal. In addition to a government-sponsored model, Glocal has now decided to launch the entrepreneurship model to expand the reach of healthcare to the un-served and the under-served.

basic_profile.name: Milind Sharma
basic_profile.headline: SVP at Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
Entrepreneurial operator with 15+ years of experience building and scaling businesses across e-commerce, quick commerce and logistics.

I currently lead the Express Parcel business at Delhivery, enabling e-commerce companies to reach customers across India through a fast, reliable and efficient logistics network.

Previously co-founded PepperTap, where I led business strategy and expansion, scaling the hyperlocal grocery platform to $200M+ ARR and raising $50M from investors including Sequoia, Elevation, Snapdeal, RTP Global and Beenext.

At Nuvo Logistics, I led business and operations, scaling the company to $10M+ revenue across 75+ cities before its acquisition by Shadowfax.

Earlier at Delhivery, as part of the early team, I helped scale the business from 0 to 100K daily orders, leading business development and key partnerships. I later joined Shadowfax, where I led growth and strategic initiatives.

Most recently, I co-founded Flyo (quick commerce) and Mabel (jewelry commerce), raising ~$2.5M from investors including Whiteboard, Sauce VC and Incubate Fund.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Shadowfax is building the infrastructure behind India's fast-moving commerce economy.For over 11 years, we have enabled businesses to move faster, reach further, and serve customers better. Today, leading brands including Nykaa, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho, Mokobara, and Dot & Key rely on Shadowfax to power deliveries across the country.As consumer expectations continue to evolve, speed has become a defining force in commerce. Shadowfax enables businesses to meet those expectations through a technology-driven logistics platform built on scale, reliability, and operational excellence.From same-day and next-day delivery to 30-minute hyperlocal fulfilment, express parcel, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions, we support the full spectrum of modern commerce. Whether enabling rapid deliveries for quick commerce brands or helping enterprises serve customers across India, our platform is built to move commerce at speed.Our network spans 15,656+ PIN codes across India and is powered by 2.6 lakh+ quarterly delivery partners, 3,500+ trucks, and 4.7 million+ square feet of operational infrastructure. It is the infrastructure that powers growth, shapes customer experience, and keeps commerce moving. Through technology, intelligent automation, sustainable mobility, and relentless execution, we are building the future of commerce movement in India.Because commerce moves at Shadowfax speed.

past.employee_description:
PepperTap was a mobile-first, on-demand grocery delivery service, which at scale was present in ~20 cities. At peak we did about ~50,000+ transactions per day, 5 million-plus transactions cumulatively. The company had peak GMV run-rate of 200 mn. USD+

Overlooked Business Expansion, Growth & Marketing and Strategy functions.

The company raised over 50M US$ from Sequoia Capital, SAIF Partners, Snapdeal & others. Pivoted back to B2B logistics (NuvoEx) due to low business margins, high burn rate in customer-facing business and overall weak investment climate. 

We were the 3rd biggest grocery e-tailer in India at the time of pivot.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi is one of the 23 IITs created to be National Centres of Excellence for training, research and development in science, engineering and technology in India. Established as College of Engineering in 1961, the Institute was later declared as an Institution of National Importance under the "Institutes of Technology (Amendment) Act, 1963" and was renamed as "Indian Institute of Technology Delhi'. Since its inception, over 50,000 have graduated from IIT Delhi, of which more than 5500 are with a Ph.D. degree, in various disciplines including Engineering, Physical Sciences, Management and Humanities & Social Sciences. In 2018, IIT Delhi received the special status of Institution of Eminence (IoE) by the Govt. of India, giving it greater autonomy in various matters including hiring of foreign faculty and starting collaborations with foreign institutions.

Shadowfax is building the infrastructure behind India's fast-moving commerce economy.For over 11 years, we have enabled businesses to move faster, reach further, and serve customers better. Today, leading brands including Nykaa, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho, Mokobara, and Dot & Key rely on Shadowfax to power deliveries across the country.As consumer expectations continue to evolve, speed has become a defining force in commerce. Shadowfax enables businesses to meet those expectations through a technology-driven logistics platform built on scale, reliability, and operational excellence.From same-day and next-day delivery to 30-minute hyperlocal fulfilment, express parcel, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions, we support the full spectrum of modern commerce. Whether enabling rapid deliveries for quick commerce brands or helping enterprises serve customers across India, our platform is built to move commerce at speed.Our network spans 15,656+ PIN codes across India and is powered by 2.6 lakh+ quarterly delivery partners, 3,500+ trucks, and 4.7 million+ square feet of operational infrastructure. Having delivered more than 1.5 billion shipments, Shadowfax has emerged as one of India's largest logistics platforms and a trusted partner to some of the country's most recognised brands.We believe logistics is no longer just about moving parcels. It is the infrastructure that powers growth, shapes customer experience, and keeps commerce moving. Through technology, intelligent automation, sustainable mobility, and relentless execution, we are building the future of commerce movement in India.Because commerce moves at Shadowfax speed.

basic_profile.name: Anmol Mallawat
basic_profile.headline: Operations Excellence | Supply Chain Strategy | Last-Mile Logistics | AI & Data Analytics | Delhivery | Ninjacart | IIM Mumbai (NITIE)
basic_profile.summary: I am a logistics and supply chain leader with a passion for building, scaling, and transforming large-scale last-mile operations. Over the years, I have led high-performing teams, delivered sustainable business growth, and driven operational excellence through data, technology, and people-centric leadership.As Director – Last Mile Operations at Delhivery, I lead end-to-end operations across the Hyderabad, Pune, and Goa regions, with responsibility for operational performance, P&L, network expansion, customer experience, workforce planning, and business growth. I currently oversee a network of 190 Delivery Centers, managing over 260,000 shipments every day through a team comprising 4 Senior Managers, 20 Managers, 500+ on-roll employees, and 2,700+ delivery partners.One of my key achievements has been scaling the Hyderabad network from 55 to 100 Delivery Centers, enabling rapid business growth while maintaining operational efficiency and service quality. My leadership philosophy is centered on building scalable processes, developing strong teams, leveraging technology and AI, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.My contributions have been recognized through a promotion from Senior Manager to Director, reflecting sustained business impact and leadership. I have also been honored as the Best Director among Metro Cities and the Best Director nationally in Delhivery Premier League (DPL) for two consecutive years, recognizing excellence in operational performance and execution.Prior to Delhivery, I worked with Ninjacart, where I led multiple supply chain initiatives focused on improving the efficiency of the fresh produce ecosystem. My work involved solving complex operational challenges across last-mile logistics, network planning, process improvement, and execution in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.I hold an MBA (PGDM) from NITIE (now IIM Mumbai), where I actively participated in national-level case competitions and earned recognition across both corporate and business school competitions. These experiences strengthened my analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and leadership capabilities.I am passionate about leveraging AI, automation, analytics, and digital transformation to build resilient, customer-centric logistics networks. I enjoy collaborating with leaders who are shaping the future of supply chain, logistics, and operations, and I am always open to meaningful conversations and new opportunities.

current.employee_description: Own last-mile operations across three regions — 180+ DCs, ~275,000 shipments/day, and a 3,200+ member workforce (4 senior managers, 20 managers, 500+ on-roll staff, 2,700+ riders). Near-doubled network capacity: scaled Hyderabad 55→100 DCs (70K→160K daily), Pune 41→60 DCs (50K→85K), and Goa 15→22 DCs (14K→29K) — the latter against 30% migrant-rider inflow — capturing ~60% of Hyderabad’s B2C demand at best-in-class performance. Delivered ~₹25 crore in annual savings — cut fixed cost-per-shipment 17% and biker cost-per-shipment 10.5% across the three-region network. Sustained delivery SLAs of 90–92% across all three regions through demand–supply planning and capacity planning against sales forecasts. Absorbed festive-season peak surges of ~1.5x daily volume while holding SLA at 89% — the performance behind back-to-back “Best Director” awards. Drove Delhivery’s first full 0→100% regional EV transition (Pune) — owning charging-infra and rider retraining — cutting cost-per-vanday from ₹878 to ₹438 and overall cost-per-shipment from ₹42.9 to ₹12.8. Single-handedly built the STM real-time ops dashboard end-to-end — AI logic, analytics, and UX/UI — then handed it to product for launch; now the standard tool at every last-mile level, cutting forward & reverse aging 27%. Revamped the field-executive app (incentives, visibility, product-mix CPS tracking) and built MCDM performance scorecards, cutting rider churn 12%.

· Managed end-to-end gateway operations across Madhya Pradesh, overseeing 12 operational centers and a workforce of over 1,500.
· Subsequently led gateway operations for Odisha & Chhattisgarh, along with Kolkata Fulfillment Centers, managing 24 centers and more than 2,000 personnel during a critical transition period.
· Appointed to lead Kolkata Gateway, Delhivery's 4th largest gateway, overseeing First Mile, Mid Mile, and Last Mile operations across a 3.91 lakh sq. ft. facility with processing capacity of 300K shipments/day, handling 200K hub in/out shipments/day, 350 tonnes/day B2B pickups, 170K B2C pickups/day, 110 tonnes/day Last Mile throughput, and a workforce of 1,500+

Key Achievements
. Recognized with Delhivery's Best Director Award (2025) for delivering exceptional operational performance during the Durga Puja peak season by maintaining industry-leading service levels despite severe no-entry restrictions, traffic disruptions, and record shipment volumes.
· Reduced First Mile CPK by 14% and Last Mile CPK by 17% through network redesign, route optimization, and fleet cross-utilization in Kolkata.
· Delivered annual savings of ₹2 crore by leading a productivity transformation initiative at Indore, the largest gateway in Madhya Pradesh.
· Reduced regional operating expenditure by 33% by optimizing fleet utilization across First Mile, Mid Mile, and Last Mile operations in Indore.
·Maintained 97%+ service levels during the 2026 West Bengal elections, ensuring uninterrupted operations despite local disruptions.
·Ranked Kolkata as the top-performing gateway in three out of four quarters, securing second position in the remaining quarter.
·Achieved 630 tonnes/day B2B First Mile pickup at Kolkata—the third-highest daily pickup across India—without compromising operational metrics.
· Achieved 250 tonnes/day B2B First Mile pickup at Indore—the first gateway in West India to reach the milestone.

Motherson is a diversified global design, engineering, manufacturing, assembly and logistics (D.E.M.A.L.) specialist, delivering full-system solutions to customers across a wide range of industries. With a robust network of 475+ state-of-the-art facilities across 47 countries, and a dedicated workforce of more than 205,000 professionals, Motherson is continually working toward its vision of being a globally preferred sustainable solutions provider for its stakeholders. The group recorded revenues of USD 22.9 billion in 2025-26 and is ranked among the top 15 automotive suppliers worldwide.As a trusted partner to OEM customers, Motherson offers an extensive, versatile product portfolio spanning the entire spectrum of the mobility industry. This includes passenger and commercial vehicles, two- and three-wheelers, rolling stock, off-highway vehicles, earthmoving, material-handling and agricultural machinery. Its product range encompasses electrical distribution systems, fully assembled vehicle interior and exterior modules, rear vision systems, moulded plastic parts and assemblies, injection moulding tools, rubber components, lighting systems, and machined metal products.Beyond the automotive sector, Motherson has strategically diversified into industries such as health and medical, aerospace, consumer electronics, logistics, and industrial IT solutions. This expansion reflects the group’s adaptability and unwavering commitment to meeting its customers' evolving needs.Motherson believes its employees are its partners in progress, its biggest asset. The organisation nurtures an environment where employees thrive as dynamic professionals and individuals. The organisation is responsive to its employees' professional aspirations and provides a range of growth opportunities, enabling them to advance professionally and to take on strategic roles within the organisation.

basic_profile.name: Ankur Singhal
basic_profile.headline: Supply Chain & Logistics Leader | Enterprise Sales | Business Transformation | Building Scalable Networks & Tech-Enabled Solutions | Driving Growth & Profitability
basic_profile.summary: I am a Supply Chain & Logistics leader with extensive experience across enterprise sales, business development, strategic account management and end-to-end supply chain solutions, with experience spanning global logistics, e-commerce and technology-led logistics businesses.My career has included leadership roles with FedEx, Ecom Express and Delhivery, giving me exposure to diverse logistics models and customers across B2B, B2C and e-commerce.At FedEx, I worked across international and domestic business, with a strong focus on acquiring, onboarding and managing large enterprise customers and building long-term strategic relationships.At Ecom Express, I gained deep exposure to the rapidly evolving e-commerce logistics ecosystem, working with leading digital commerce businesses and understanding the complexities of high-volume, time-sensitive fulfilment and distribution.At Delhivery, my focus has expanded into building and delivering end-to-end supply chain solutions across warehousing, transportation, distribution and fulfilment. I work closely with large enterprises to solve complex supply chain challenges, design scalable operating models and create commercially sustainable solutions.My key areas of expertise include:• Enterprise Sales & Strategic Account Management• Supply Chain Design & Transformation• Warehousing, Distribution & Transportation• B2B, B2C & E-commerce Logistics• Network Strategy & Optimisation• Business Development & New Customer Acquisition• Commercial Strategy & Negotiations• Technology-enabled Supply Chain Solutions• Cross-functional Business & Operations LeadershipI enjoy working at the intersection of business, operations and technology—understanding the customer's problem, challenging conventional approaches and building solutions that create measurable and sustainable value.My leadership philosophy is simple: Own the outcome. Stay close to the customer. Build for scale.I am passionate about building businesses, transforming supply chains, creating differentiated customer propositions and driving profitable growth at scale.

Yamaha made its initial foray into India in 1985. In August 2001, Yamaha Motor India became a 100% subsidiary of Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd, Japan (YMC). In 2008, Mitsui & Co., Ltd. entered into an agreement with YMC to become a joint-investor in the company "India Yamaha Motor Private Limited (IYM)". IYM's manufacturing facilities comprise of 2 State-of-the-art Plants at Surajpur (Uttar Pradesh) and Faridabad (Haryana). The infrastructure at both the plants supports production of motorcycles and parts for the domestic as well as overseas markets.With a strong workforce of more than 2,300 employees, IYM is highly customer-driven and has a countrywide network of over 1200 customer touch-points including 400 dealers. Presently, its product portfolio includes Fazer25 (249 cc), FZ25 (249 cc), YZF-R15 Version 2.0 (149.8cc), YZF-R15s (149cc), Fazer-FI (149cc), FZS-FI (149 cc), FZ (153cc), FZ-FI (149 cc), SZ - RR Version 2.0 (149 cc), Saluto (125cc) and Scooters Ray Z (113cc), Alpha (113cc), Fascino(113cc) & Ray ZR(113cc)Import portfolio includes YZF-R1 (998cc), MT-09 (847cc).

past.employer_linkedin_description: lifecare health (previously LifCare) is India’s largest Subscription pharmacy for chronic patients and is making chronic health management affordable and convenient for everyone. India has ~25% of its population suffering from chronic diseases and about 1/3 rd of this population does not adhere to its maintenance medicine - leading to hospitalization and sky-rocketing healthcare costs. We lost ~300,000 lives to Diabetes alone in 2015 due to non-adherence. We, at lifecare health, believe we can save these lives. We are redefining chronic disease management and the medicine supply chain using intelligent technology and data science that includes refills management, prescription digitization, offline to online shift, medicine reminders, intelligent warehouse stocking and smart logistics.Founded in late 2015 by a team consisting of IIT/IIM alumni having several years of industry experience in companies, lifecare health aims to enhance the whole pharmacy experience for patients by providing a relationship-oriented, technology-driven and convenient environment. From proactive monthly refills to updating dosages to making sure adherence improves, we at lifecare health take care of everything. We are an ideal healthcare center for patients on long duration medicines for Diabetes, Heart, Hypertension, Thyroid, Kidney disorders, etc. We are proud to be in an industry that can make a real difference to millions of lives! Write to us at care@lifcare.in or visit us at www.lifecarehealth.com to know more!

basic_profile.name: Gourav Bhardwaj
basic_profile.headline: Human Resources Business Partner
basic_profile.summary:
I am an adaptable, resourceful, and enthusiastic individual with considerable experience in administrative work. I have excellent organizational skills and the ability to perform a variety of professional level MIS Operation functions for Staffing an organization that requires a range of knowledge and skills within my area of expertise also possess team working qualities that help me work together to achieve our goals at all times. 
To develop and establish my career as an efficient professional and to work with an organization that gives scope to update my knowledge and skills in order to achieve mutual growth and benefit. 

Recruitment & Selection: 
✅ Responsible for Recruitment, Selection & shortlisting the candidates. Sourcing the possible candidates via the sourcing procedures like job portals, walk-ins, and employees’ references, followed by screening and shortlisting of candidates. 
✅Conducting the first round of HR Interviews to evaluate communication, attitude, and commitment of the candidate towards the organization. Follow-up with the candidates till they joining 
Onboarding, Induction & Joining formalities: 
✅ Taking Induction sessions for the junior, Executive & Middle-level entrants in the Organization, Ensured induction of all employees as per the defined process. 
✅Manage business letters related to employee’s offer & appointment letter, service agreement, background verification, , allowances, request for evidence, transfer related documentation etc. 
Payroll Management: 
✅ Verify Time & Leave Management for timely and ensure accurate processing of the Monthly Payroll according to the schedule, Generating Pay slips and forwarding them to employees. 
✅ Manage regular preparation of relevant MIS reports, including weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end reports (gross payroll, hours worked, vacation accrual, tax deductions, benefit deductions, etc.) 
✅ Manage employee queries with regard to their deductions, settlements, and supporting their requirements. 
✅Strict adherence and compliances with the provisions of various Lab. our legislations (Shops Act, EPF, ESI, PT, etc.,) Registrations & Renewals, etc... 
✅P.F, E.S.I., P.T & Gratuity - Calculations, Remittances. 
✅Timely updating of Attendance & Leave Management in the HRIS System, verify & process record data of each employee for Gratuity, Mediclaim, and Insurance details. 
✅Part of HR Shared Services team for attending & assigning Internal / External Employees queries regards to onboarding, leave, payroll, F&F settlements, performance appraisals, etc.

basic_profile.name: Prashant Kalra
basic_profile.headline: Vice President - LTL/B2B Business at Delhivery | P&L Owner, ₹125 Cr to ₹550 Cr Scale-up | Built PSU Vertical from Zero | Enterprise Sales & GTM Strategy | Ex-Airtel | Logistics · Telecom · Media
basic_profile.summary: I scale B2B businesses. Over 23 years, I have owned P&L across logistics, telecom, and media - building teams, designing go-to-market strategies, and turning early-stage verticals into large, profitable franchises.  At Delhivery, I took the LTL/B2B business from a ₹125 Cr portfolio to a ₹550 Cr national mandate through three progressive leadership roles over five years. I built and led a pan-India organisation of 100+ people - Regional Directors, senior managers, and key account managers - across Focus, Strategic, and PSU account segments.  What I am most known for:→ Built Delhivery's PSU vertical from zero - designed the GTM, hired the team, and closed a ₹185 Cr partnership with HPCL, the largest deal in the company's history→ Secured multi-year enterprise contracts with Bosch, Maruti, 3M, ITC, and Daimler - displacing entrenched incumbents at scale  → Delivered 32% revenue growth at HT Media and exceeded 35% EBITDA margin with ₹40 Cr+ absolute profitability across 3 stations in West India→ Managed a ₹1,000 MN major accounts portfolio at Bharti Airtel - 65% revenue growth, highest in Mumbai circle → Ranked National No. 1 ASM at Reliance for three consecutive quarters and earned CEO Award, Annual Leadership Awards (2024 and 2025), and ITC's "Most Reliable PTL Partner" recognition at Delhivery → Guest faculty at IIM Jammu - conducted a session on "Understanding Logistics: The Journey from Warehouse to Delivery"  My operating strengths sit at the intersection of P&L ownership, B2B revenue strategy, GTM design, enterprise and CXO-level sales, strategic account management, new vertical creation, and cross-functional leadership across sales, operations, and customer success. I have consistently shifted teams from traditional selling to new-age, data-driven methods - and I build organisations that sustain growth beyond any one deal or quarter.  Committed to driving business transformation, accelerating profitable growth, and contributing at an enterprise level as I continue progressing toward CXO leadership.

basic_profile.name: Dr Harish Sharma
basic_profile.headline: Vice President -  Delhivery, IIM Lucknow .
basic_profile.summary:
In an experience of more than 27years, I have achieved success in building profitable organizations, delivering competitive edge for revenue growth in start-up, mature and turnaround environments, strengthening operational excellence, and setting up scalable infrastructure from scratch for sales, marketing and distribution channels. 

I have headed large-scale business operations, developed and launched pioneering products, improved brand value, achieved leadership position in market share, driven growth to generate annual turnover in excess of INR 4500 crore (USD 60+ million), and increased margins in highly competitive markets.

Colleagues and business partners acknowledge me as an inspirational leader, value creator and business strategist, adept at adjusting quickly to challenges, leveraging business opportunities, and dealing effectively with key stakeholders.

Highlights:

At Aircel, I developed and led high-performing teams of up to 1000 people, established efficient technical, operational and manpower capabilities, built new business and distribution networks from the ground up, and turned around operations from EBITDA loss of INR 400 crore to EBITDA profit of INR 100+ crore within 2 years. At present I am heading the Wireless Business for West Region Circle.
While with Vodafone, I doubled the top line in one year, achieved market leadership position, and increased the subscriber base by penetrating new markets.

Specialities: 

P&L Management | Business Planning | Business Development | Go-to-market | Brand & Product Portfolio Management | Channel Partner Management | Budget & Margin Management | Post-M&A Integration | Team Building

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers. At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

*This page is run by ex-Employees of Aircel, as a platform to keep in touch and share memories. We do not provide any support or services to ex-customers of Aircel.*Aircel Ltd. was an Indian mobile network operator headquartered in Mumbai that offered voice and 2G and 3G data services. Maxis Communications held a 74% stake and Sindya Securities and Investments held the remaining 26%.Aircel was founded by Chinnakannan Sivasankaran and commenced operations in Tamil Nadu in 1999. It was once a market leader in Tamil Nadu and had considerable presence in Odisha, Assam and North-East telecom circles. 2G and 3G Services including voice were shut down in all circles after failure of merger talks with Reliance Communications.As of December 2017, Aircel had a subscriber base of over 84.93 million and was India's sixth-largest GSM mobile service provider.[24] With presence in 22 circles, Aircel was a market leader in Tamil Nadu and had considerable presence in Odisha, Assam and North-East circles. In 2012, as a part of a major re-organization in its operations, the company scaled down its operations in five telecom circles, namely Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Haryana, Kerala and Punjab. In April 2015, Aircel relaunched its service in Kerala.Now Aircel is under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process From 12 March 2018.Aircel was the main shirt sponsor of Indian Premier League cricket team Chennai Super Kings and I-League football team Shillong Lajong FC. Aircel was also the principal sponsor for Atlético de Kolkata FC who play in the Indian Super League football competition. It was also a major sponsor of the Chennai Open ATP tennis tournament and the Professional Golf Tour of India. Aircel also sponsored the Save the Tiger campaign for protecting India's tigers. The brand ambassadors of Aircel included the Indian cricket team captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni and Tamil actor Suriya. Aircel also engaged with boxer Mary Kom, Tamil actors Dhanush and Sameera Reddy.

The Indian Army is the largest branch of the Indian Armed Forces and is responsible for land-based military operations. Its primary mission is the National Security and Defense of India from external aggression and threats, and maintaining peace and security within its borders. It also conducts humanitarian rescue operations during natural calamities and other disturbances. The Indian Army is one of the three services under the Ministry of Defence.The President of India is the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, and thus of the Indian Army. The highest ranking military officer is the Chief of Army Staff (COAS), who is also a member of the Chiefs of Staff Committee.The Indian Army came into being at the Independence of India in 1947, and inherited most of the regiments and infrastructure of the British Indian Army that were located in post-partition India.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Government of India is responsible for ensuring the defence of India and every part thereof. The Supreme Command of the Armed Forces vests in the President. The responsibility for national defence rests with the Cabinet. This is discharged through the Ministry of Defence, which provides the policy framework and wherewithal to the Armed Forces to discharge their responsibilities in the context of the defence of the country. The Raksha Mantri (Defence Minister) is the head of the Ministry of Defence. The principal task of the Defence Ministry is to obtain policy directions of the Government on all defence and security related matters and communicate them for implementation to the Services Headquarters, Inter-Services Organisations, Production Establishments and Research and Development Organisations. It is also required to ensure effective implementation of the Government's policy directions and the execution of approved programmes within the allocated resources. Ministry of Defence comprises of four Departments viz. Department of Defence (DOD), Department of Defence Production  (DDP), Department of Defence Research & Development (DDR&D) and Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare and also Finance Division.

past.employee_description:
Handling last-mile operations:

* On-time delivery rate:  The percentage of deliveries completed within the promised timeframe.
* Delivery cost per order:  The average cost of delivering a single order.
* Customer satisfaction:  A measure of customer happiness with the delivery experience.
* First-mile delivery time:  The time it takes to get the order from the warehouse to the delivery vehicle.
* Average delivery time:  The average time it takes to deliver an order to the customer.
* Number of delivery attempts:  The number of times a delivery driver needs to attempt to deliver an order.
* Delivery route efficiency:  A measure of how efficiently delivery routes are planned and executed.
* Driver performance:  A measure of driver productivity and adherence to company policies.
* Delivery failure rate:  The percentage of deliveries that fail to be completed successfully.
* Return rate:  The percentage of orders that are returned after delivery.
* Order fulfillment rate:  The percentage of orders that are fulfilled and delivered on time.

basic_profile.summary: P&L leader with a 15-year track record across consumer internet and telecom in India. My career has been built around three things: owning P&Ls at scale, building teams that deliver on the ground, and running the operating cadence that turns strategy into outcomes.At Zomato (Eternal), I lead Customer Experience for the platform. The role spans policy, contact centre operations, and the partner programs that connect customers, restaurants, and riders. Prior to this, I led the Bharat business covering Zomato's emerging cities portfolio. Before that, I was City CEO for the Chandigarh cluster and City Head across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, and Rajasthan.I joined Zomato from Bharti Airtel, where I led sales for the Rajasthan circle and earlier ran sales strategy and go-to-market for the national DTH business from Gurugram. I began my career at Videocon d2h with progressively senior roles in area sales, program management, and cluster sales leadership across Delhi, Mumbai, and Hyderabad.Core capabilities include P&L ownership at scale, new market entry, supply and channel network development, sales and distribution leadership, large-team management, and operations governance.MBA, IIM Kozhikode. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. past.employer_linkedin_description: TalentPad is a unique online platform having the promise to disrupt the hiring industry, currently governed by traditional channels like job-boards and recruitment agencies. They're a marketplace connecting high quality talent with technology companies through a unique concept of a TalentFair. TalentFair is basically a week long online event, conducted periodically, which sees participation of high quality candidates and hundreds of employers across a selected few roles.They act as a platform for the candidate to showcase his profile to hundreds of employers in a week, and in the process get multiple interview opportunities with upfront compensation and other details. Post that the candidate decides where to interview, and gets hired in a matter of days. The nature of the marketplace ensures that he gets to explore the market fairly well, thus receiving the best opportunity from the market.

As Co-Founder and CTO, I owned Technology and Product functions, and was instrumental in
•	Building first version of product from scratch alone
•	Building a team of 12 exceptionally talented engineers and designers with great past experiences
•	Integration of acquired assessment platform OptimizedBits in early 2015.

Trevo plans to make your daily travel much more convenient, reliable and hassle-free. 

Today either there are low-cost public transport options like the bus / metros which cost < Rs 2 /km, but are extremely uncomfortable and overcrowded, or at the other spectrum there are door-to-door options like Uber / UberPool, which are convenient but heavy on the pocket (i.e. > Rs 10-15 /km), to be used for daily use. Auto are in the middle, which are somewhat convenient but again decently expensive (~Rs 10 /km). There is a huge gap in between, a massive market to be addressed. 

Trevo is a network of private buses and mini-buses, which are highly convenient, predictable and reliable for your daily travel, maybe it be to your workplace or to your college or to your tuition class or whatsoever it maybe. It gives you the convenience to pre-book your seat, to track your bus in real-time, so now no waiting at the bus stop, enjoy your in-bus ride with value added services like free high-speed wifi, magazines / newspapers, charging stations, in-bus entertainment system, and of course a place to connect with your co-travellers.

We are a passionate bunch of entrepreneurs who aspire and will solve this problem using tech. and robust processes.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Established in 1884 by Rinaldo Piaggio, since 2003 the Piaggio Group has been controlled by Immsi S.p.A., an industrial holding listed on the Italian stock exchange.The Piaggio Group product range includes scooters, mopeds and motorcycles marketed under the Piaggio, Vespa, Gilera, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi, Derbi and Scarabeo brands. past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

DigiAlly is a financial infrastructure company that leverages AI-driven solutions to advance financial inclusion for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and mid-market companies. At its core, the platform provides an AI-powered trust score evaluating SMEs across credit, operational, and market risks – streamlining credit assessments for institutional lenders through unified risk quantification. This approach replaces fragmented evaluation methods with a holistic view of business viability.The platform tackles information asymmetry between SMEs and corporations by integrating nontraditional data points – including supply chain interactions, digital transaction patterns, and market positioning metrics – alongside conventional financial indicators. Through proprietary machine learning models, DigiAlly’s API solution also enables real-time portfolio monitoring and predictive risk analytics, allowing lenders to dynamically adjust credit terms and optimize collection strategies as market conditions evolve.Key benefits include reduced reliance on backward-looking financial statements, expanded credit access for businesses lacking formal credit histories, and scalable infrastructure for lenders to grow SME portfolios profitably. Early adopters report 40% faster credit decision cycles and 25% reductions in default rates compared to traditional underwriting models, according to pilot data from partner institutions.DigiAlly’s risk assessment framework now extends beyond lending to address third-party risks across industries. Payment processors use the platform to evaluate merchant viability, while logistics firms apply it to assess supply chain partners’ operational resilience. This expansion reflects growing recognition that AI-powered trust metrics can mitigate counterparty risks in B2B transactions. By transforming opaque business relationships into data-driven partnerships, the platform aims to redefine how enterprises collaborate in the trust-based digital economy.

BYJU’S is a global ed-tech company, providing highly adaptive, engaging and effective learning solutions to more than 150 million students around the world. Founded in India in 2011, BYJU’S mission is to make high-quality learning accessible to students everywhere.The BYJU’S family of brands includes Disney-BYJU’S Early Learn, BYJU’S Future School, Epic!, Osmo, Tynker, Toppr and WhiteHat Jr, along with our beloved flagship product BYJU’S – The Learning App. Together, BYJU’S solutions support Pre-K – 12 education and a wide range of competitive exams. BYJU’S delivers a world-class learning experience with tools that sit at the cross-section of mobile, interactive content and personalized learning methodologies. BYJU’S geography-agnostic solutions and 12,000+ teachers make learning engaging, with visual and contextual programs that adapt to the unique learning style, skill level and pace of each student. In addition, we have innovative partnerships with some of the world’s leading companies, including Disney and Google, to drive engagement and help even more students become active and lifelong learners. BYJU’S is backed by blue-chip investors including the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Sequoia Capital, Bond Capital, Silver Lake, BlackRock, Sands Capital Management, Alkeon Capital Management, Sofina, Verlinvest, Tencent, Prosus (previously Naspers Ventures), CPPIB, General Atlantic, Tiger Global, Qatar Investment Authority, Owl Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Times Internet, Aarin Capital and IFC. Since 2017, we have completed more than 15 acquisitions, including companies in the U.S., UK, Austria, India and Singapore. A 2021 Time 100 Most Influential Company, BYJU’S is headquartered in India, with operations in more than 21 countries globally and learning programs in multiple languages. For additional information, please visit www.byjus.com.

Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) traces its origin to the formative years of an emerging nation - India. Incorporated in 1974, NFL is India's largest CPSE in Fertilizer Sector with a turnover of over Rs. 90 billion. It is the second largest producer of the key fertiliser Urea in India with an installed capacity of 35.68 Lakh MT with a 16% share in total urea production of country. NFL operates five gas based Ammonia-Urea plants viz Nangal & Bathinda in Punjab, Panipat in Haryana and two plants at Vijaipur (Madhya Pradesh) and a Bio-fertilizers plant in Vijaipur. The company has recently started production of Bentonite Sulphur at its Panipat Unit. NFL is engaged in manufacturing and marketing of Neem Coated Urea, four strains of Bio-Fertilizers (solid & liquid) and other allied Industrial products like Ammonia, Nitric Acid, Ammonium Nitrate, Sodium Nitrite and Sodium Nitrate. The brand name of the company is popularly known in the market as ‘KISAN’. The company has also started production of certified seeds under its flagship Seeds Multiplication Program.Apart from manufacturing business, the company is trading various agro-inputs like imported Non-Urea Fertilizers, certified seeds, Agro chemicals, City compost through its existing pan India dealer’s network under single window concept.NFL Marketing Network comprises of Central Marketing Office at NOIDA, four Zonal Offices at Bhopal, Lucknow & Chandigarh and Hyderabad, 16 State & 2 UT Offices and 35 Area offices spread across the marketing territory of NFL.The company is also playing a pivotal role in extending various agricultural extension services such as educating the farmers on judicious use of fertilizers along with total know-how on improved and scientific methods of cultivation to improve soil productivity. NFL in a JV with M/s EIL and M/s FCIL is setting up a state of the art 12.70 Lakh MT Urea Plant at Ramagundam in Telangana and also looking forward for expansion of its footprints globally by setting up the fertilizer plants. The company has a well-trained manpower of around 3500 employees.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. Our vision is to "harness space technology for national development", while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration. ISRO is managed by the Department of Space (DoS) of the Government of India.Indian Space Research Organisation, formed in 1969, superseded the erstwhile INCOSPAR. ISRO is one of the six largest space agencies in the world. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites.Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

past.employee_description:
Conceptualized from scratch and developed the core IP of the business - Machine Learning based Automated Alternative Credit Evaluation Model. Main contribution here was identifying the initial 2000+ alternative variables for the cashflow based alternative lending single-handedly and building the analytical framework. Earlier experience as CFO with an insight into the fact that bank statement is a good proxy to a single entry accounting book as well as having used analytics in earlier stints was quite instrumental in developing this model using variables which were significantly quantitative in nature.
 
As COO in the initial years, I was responsible for setting up processes in functions like Credit, Risk, Product, Analytics, Collections, HR and Finance. Developed the first business plan for the company. Developed the Alternative Credit Risk Management framework and effectively serving as the Risk Officer as well. 

January 2017 onwards I also worked as CEO at Lendingkart Finance Limited (NBFC arm of Lendingkart Group) overseeing all the functions like Credit, Risk, Collections, HR, Finance,  Analytics, Product as well as Tech, and delivering one of the best financial performances in the fintech sector in FY 2018-2019, with a Revenue of INR 225 cr and PBT of INR 31cr in the NBFC. I had nine(9) function heads/CXOs reporting into me, namely the CBO, CTO, CPO, CAO, CFO, Head of Credit, Head of Risk, Head of HR, Head of Collections. It was this splendid team through the targets were achieved.

Contributed immensely to fund raises - especially Series B (USD 20mn) and Series C2 (USD 75mn) fund raises for the company and big ticket debt raises through investor interactions and delivery of exceptional credit performance.

Lendingkart was ranked 23rd among top 100 fintech innovators globally in the 2016 and 2018 KPMG Fintech 100 report and has been ranked 33rd globally in 2017 report and was highest ranked fintech lending company from India to be part of the top 50 list.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

past.employee_title: Director of Product Management - Platform and Ecosystem
past.employee_description:
As Director of Platform Product at Delhivery, I oversaw the end-to-end product strategy, definition, and launch of OS1 (Delhivery’s SaaS business), a multi-tenant platform that streamlines logistics and supply chain application development. OS1 provides foundational services—including business-agnostic APIs and UI components for authentication, user management, and notifications—alongside core logistics building blocks such as order management, motion tracking, workflow builders, dispatch, and resource representation. I introduced comprehensive developer tooling, encompassing APIs, SDKs, and CLI utilities, to accelerate application development. Additionally, I established a marketplace ecosystem that empowers third-party developers to distribute and monetize their solutions through built-in subscription management and payment processing.

More details on APIs @ https://docs.getos1.com

past.employee_description:
As Senior Executive (IT), I served 4,000+ corporate eCommerce clients, automating DHL’s electronic shipping and logistics workflows. I led projects like Yellow Box and the migration of 300+ workstations to a new office, ensuring zero downtime IT operations. I also drove process automation wins that reduced errors and improved transit time.

Achievements: 
•	Supported 4,000+ corporate customers in customized eCommerce shipping, enhancing service reliability and SLA delivery.
•	Led Yellow Box project under XiTe, improving electronic shipping and eCommerce capabilities across India.
•	Migrated 300+ workstations and India IT HUB units to a new office, maintaining zero network downtime and user experience.
•	Reduced manual errors and improved transit time by enhancing and automating logistics workflows for high volume clients.

As West Regional Learning Manager, I anchored L&D for the West zone, focusing on NHO, compliance, and real time learning technologies. I built audit mechanisms, process adherence tools, and social distance friendly learning while supporting MENA migration. I also linked learning outcomes to SLA and safety metrics.

Achievements: 
•	Led West zone L&D for Last Mile and middle mile sites, scaling targeted training and coaching modules.
•	Initiated a learning app based social distance training rollout, achieving 68% capsule completion in 7 days vs 50% target.
•	Supported MENA region (Dubai, KSA, Egypt) in migrating from Souq to Amazon systems, enabling smoother digital transition.
•	Developed audit processes for process adherence, AA performance, social distancing, and safety, improving compliance visibility.

As National Learning Manager, I led a large, cross site L&D team to standardize capability development, digital tools, and performance diagnostics. I drove national scale learning innovations, including the Associate Learning Curve, QBR, and social distance learning app. I also influenced hiring efficiency, AA ramp up, and vendor to employee mobility.

Achievements: 
•	Led a team of 31 Amazon employees and 131 PAs across 25 managed and 26 vendor sites, coordinating national training coverage.
•	Revamped New Hire Orientation from 7 hrs to 2 hrs, enabling significantly faster associate ramp up and reduced training time.
•	Developed the Associate Learning Curve, giving real time performance and skill level visibility for better workforce deployment.
•	Reduced Amazon agent hiring cycle from 19.6 to 15 days in 2021 and further to 8.3 days in 2022, unlocking multi crore savings.
•	Reduced AA ramp up duration from 12 weeks to 8 weeks and saved INR 10M across four 2021 site launches.

past.employee_title: Operations Manager – Site Leader & West MM Pick‑Up
past.employee_description:
In this role, I scaled a mid sized site and consolidated West MM pick up operations, balancing capacity constraints with aggressive volume targets. I led physical layout redesigns, Kiazan/CI initiatives, and Seller Flex/Merchant pick up growth, while tightening flow metrics and FL NC. I also managed fluctuating peak sale volumes and site level stakeholder expectations.

Achievements: 
•	Increased shipment processing from 69K to 115K/day within a 6,000 sq ft operation footprint, optimizing space utilization.
•	Delivered peak volume of 83K shipments/day at 14 shipments per sq ft, outperforming network benchmarks.
•	Improved FL NC to 0.09% within a 0.20% goal, sustaining CTPH of 117 vs 111 unit YTD target.
•	Managed 400 Seller Flex and 68 Merchant pick up sites, scaling daily volumes from 30K–50K to 190K during major sale events.

As Senior Program Manager L&D, I architected the Middle Mile L&D strategy, digital content, and intake frameworks to standardize training scalability. I built a multi language, bite sized learning architecture, rolled out a Learning App, and streamlined program governance for new trainings and intake. I also aligned L&D leadership practices with a 3 year growth roadmap.

Achievements: 
•	Set up a 3 year Digital Charter for Middle Mile L&D, defining roadmap, content standards, and execution governance.
•	Launched a Learning App enabling faster onboarding, targeted training, and horizontal skill deployment across MM sites.
•	Created a centralized L&D intake mechanism for new trainings, audience mapping, and OP level in take management.
•	Defined L&D job leveling guidelines (L3–L7) supporting structured 3 year team growth and role clarity.

As Site Leader, I transformed a large sort center by scaling capacity, redesigning workflows, and embedding continuous improvement practices at the floor level. I led a high volume team, introduced material handling innovations, and tightened process controls to balance throughput, safety, and ergonomics. I also partnered with HR and engineering to align hiring, space, and performance metrics with business goals.
Achievements: 
•	Achieved 200% growth in shipment processing capacity, scaling to 350K daily shipments at the large sort center.
•	Rolled out Power Bagging, Self Levelling Bins, and Driver Dugouts, improving workflow efficiency and floor ergonomics.
•	Drove productivity to 106% vs 111 unit goal, recognized as the best in network performance at Amazon India ATS.
•	Partnered with HR on practical floor assessments, improving candidate role fit and reducing recruitment to ramp up cycle time.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Shadowfax is building the infrastructure behind India's fast-moving commerce economy.For over 11 years, we have enabled businesses to move faster, reach further, and serve customers better. Today, leading brands including Nykaa, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho, Mokobara, and Dot & Key rely on Shadowfax to power deliveries across the country.As consumer expectations continue to evolve, speed has become a defining force in commerce. Shadowfax enables businesses to meet those expectations through a technology-driven logistics platform built on scale, reliability, and operational excellence.From same-day and next-day delivery to 30-minute hyperlocal fulfilment, express parcel, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions, we support the full spectrum of modern commerce. Whether enabling rapid deliveries for quick commerce brands or helping enterprises serve customers across India, our platform is built to move commerce at speed.Our network spans 15,656+ PIN codes across India and is powered by 2.6 lakh+ quarterly delivery partners, 3,500+ trucks, and 4.7 million+ square feet of operational infrastructure. Having delivered more than 1.5 billion shipments, Shadowfax has emerged as one of India's largest logistics platforms and a trusted partner to some of the country's most recognised brands.We believe logistics is no longer just about moving parcels. It is the infrastructure that powers growth, shapes customer experience, and keeps commerce moving. Through technology, intelligent automation, sustainable mobility, and relentless execution, we are building the future of commerce movement in India.Because commerce moves at Shadowfax speed.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

BHEL has installed over 1000 utility sets worldwide with its installed base of supplied power generating equipment exceeding 185 GW. BHEL has also commissioned 200+ electric substations & 5 major HVDC projects in the country.

Founded in 2015, Shuttl is India’s largest office commute service provider. With a mission of solving the pain of commute, Shuttl offers a space-efficient, safe, and cost-effective solution for urban India.Shuttl has demonstrated the ability to simultaneously address the dual challenge of congestion and pollution. The company catalyzes a shift away from private vehicles towards shared mobility - a win-win for citizens and cities. It also drives entrepreneurship by providing bus-owners on its platform with the latest technology, better financing, and relevant training, to help them scale and participate in offering a smarter, safer, and greener solution to bus riders.Today, Shuttl serves over 1,00,000 rides daily in seven cities including Delhi-NCR region, Mumbai, Kolkata, Pune, Chennai & Hyderabad. It covers 350+ long routes and operates a fleet of 2000 buses. It has also been awarded UK’s Ashden Award (2018) and Road Safety Award by FICCI (2017). Shuttl is backed by Sequoia Capital, Amazon Alexa Fund, Times Internet, Lightspeed Ventures, Dentsu Ventures, Toyota Tsusho & SPARX Group.
