Zenergize Power Tech Private Limited is an indigenous Indian manufacturer of Silicon Carbide (SiC) solar inverters and EV charging equipment, designed from the ground up for India’s heat, grid instability, and regulatory requirements. Our solar inverters use Infineon SiC technology - operating at 97–98% efficiency and maintaining full output at 55°C, where conventional IGBT inverters lose 10–15% capacity. All inverters are BIS IS 16221 certified, making them fully eligible for PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidies. Product range: grid-tied solar inverters (5kW, 8kW, 15kW), residential and commercial AC EV chargers (3.3–22kW), and DC fast chargers (30–240kW). All products connect to ZenSense - our proprietary solar + EV monitoring app. Founded by IIT engineers. Manufactured in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh. One of the most diversified integrated steel producers with a capacity of 36 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) across India, the Netherlands, the UK, and Thailand, Tata Steel is shaping a better tomorrow through innovation, sustainability, and an enduring commitment to excellence. The Company’s Jamshedpur, Kalinganagar and IJmuiden plants have been recognised among the World Economic Forum Advanced 4th Industrial Revolution (4IR) Global Lighthouses. With over 77,000 employees across the globe, Tata Steel is a Great Place to Work®-certified organisation. The Company recorded a consolidated turnover of approximately US$26 billion in the financial year ending March 31, 2026.Tata Steel has set an ambitious target of achieving Net Zero emissions by 2045. The newly inaugurated 0.75 MTPA electric arc furnace-based steelmaking facility in Ludhiana is the Company’s first low-emission plant in India. In the UK, Tata Steel is transitioning to a 3.2 MTPA EAF-based steelmaking route while in the Netherlands, the Company has signed a non-binding Joint Letter of Intent with the Government of the Netherlands and the Province of North-Holland on integrated decarbonisation and health measures project.Focused on sustainability, innovation, agility, and fostering deep relationships with customers and communities, Tata Steel aspires to become the most respected and valuable metals and mining company globally.

basic_profile.name: Puja Bardhan
basic_profile.headline: Product @Delhivery | IIM Bangalore
basic_profile.summary:
I'm a product leader with 9 years of experience building enterprise-grade solutions and scaling tech products from the ground up. Currently at Delhivery, I lead the TransportOne product—a B2B SaaS Transport Management System—where I've taken it from concept to market, onboarded marquee clients, and continue to scale adoption through differentiated procurement and execution workflows. I also own the P&L for our cross-docking solution for TransportOne clients, enabling direct fulfillment from client's regional warehouses, reducing costs by eliminating unnecessary handling and hops.

Before product, I spent time in management consulting at PwC, where I drove supply chain transformations, procurement efficiencies, and go-to-market strategies across sectors. I also co-founded a 30-minute hyperlocal medicine delivery startup, which, while short-lived, gave me a crash course in execution, grit, and user empathy.

I'm driven by a strong bias for action, product intuition grounded in systems thinking, and a deep interest in solving real-world logistics and marketplace problems. Outside work, I enjoy mentoring young PMs, exploring behavioral economics, and tinkering with product ideas that make everyday systems smarter and simpler.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Maharatna ONGC is the largest producer of crude oil and natural gas in India, contributing around 70 per cent of Indian domestic production. The crude oil is the raw material used by downstream companies like IOC, BPCL, HPCL to produce petroleum products like Petrol, Diesel, Kerosene, Naphtha, Cooking Gas-LPG.ONGC is India’s Top Energy Company and ranks 14th among global energy majors (Platts). It is the only Indian company to figure in Fortune’s ‘Most Admired Energy Companies’ list. ONGC ranks 226th overall in Forbes Global 2000. Acclaimed for its Corporate Governance practices, Transparency International has ranked ONGC 26th among the biggest publicly traded global giants. It is most valued public enterprise in India, and one of the highest profit-making and dividend-paying.ONGC has a unique distinction of being a company with in-house service capabilities in all areas of Exploration and Production of oil & gas and related oil-field services. Winner of the Best Employer award, a dedicated team of over 25,000 professionals toil round the clock in challenging locations.ONGC is an integrated energy company with interests in upstream, midstream and downstream sector of the hydrocarbon value chain, renewables, LNG, Power generation, petrochemicals and Value Added Products. ONGC's wholly-owned subsidiary Navratna ONGC Videsh Limited (OVL) is the biggest Indian multinational in the energy space, participating in 32 oil and gas properties in 15 countries. ONGC's subsidiary Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) is a Schedule ‘A’ Miniratna, with a single-location refining capacity of 15 million tons per annum. ONGC subsidiary HPCL is a Maharatna CPSE, and has the second largest share of product pipelines in India with a pipeline network of more than 3370 kms for transportation of petroleum products and a vast marketing network consisting of 14 Zonal offices and 133 Regional Offices.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. Our vision is to "harness space technology for national development", while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration. ISRO is managed by the Department of Space (DoS) of the Government of India.Indian Space Research Organisation, formed in 1969, superseded the erstwhile INCOSPAR. ISRO is one of the six largest space agencies in the world. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites.Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

past.employer_linkedin_description: Imagine transforming a space the size of Eden Gardens, into full-fledged co-living residences within one month. POWERGRID is a listed Company, with 57.90% holding of Government of India and balance by Institutional Investors & public. Power Grid Corporation of India limited (POWERGRID) was incorporated on October 23, 1989. POWERGRID started functioning on management basis with effect from August, 1991 and it took over transmission assets from NTPC, NHPC, NEEPCO and other Central/Joint Sector Organizations during 1992-93 in a phased manner. POWERGRID has been implementing various transmission projects for generation capacity addition under central sector, Ultra Mega Power Projects (UMPPs), Independent Power Producers (IPPs) and other projects. With rapid increase in asset base of the organisation, National Transmission Asset Management Centre (NTAMC) has been established, which is manned by experts on 24x7 basis to provide expert handling to system & equipment.

basic_profile.summary:
With over 14 years of cross-industry experience in logistics, e-commerce, and automotive technology, I currently serve as Senior Director at Delhivery, leading B2B Revenue Assurance for our LTL and FTL businesses. Throughout my career, I have held strategic finance and operations roles at Rivigo, Minda iConnect, Snapdeal, and Aramex — consistently driving scalable revenue systems, optimizing working capital, and spearheading operational transformations.

My core strengths include:

Revenue assurance and accounts receivable controls

Accounts payable, audits, and monthly financial closing

Commercial operations and dispute resolution

System automation and finance process transformation

DSO reduction and collections efficiency

P&L ownership and strategic cost optimization

Cost control and manpower cost reduction

Building and leading high-performing finance teams

Controlling revenue leakage to protect and grow business value

At Delhivery, I focus on bridging business, technology, and operations to implement sustainable, data-driven revenue processes. Notably, I have improved B2B DSO by 70 days, significantly enhancing cash flow and profitability.

Earlier, at Snapdeal, I contributed to a 200+ crore reduction in working capital and led key automation initiatives. At Rivigo, I developed scalable systems for dispute management and finance automation that strengthened operational controls.

Across all my roles, my mission remains steadfast: to elevate financial performance through stronger process visibility, governance, and accountability — while ensuring a “feel good” experience for customers by promptly addressing and resolving their finance-related concerns

basic_profile.summary:
I’m a P&L and Growth Leader with 8+ years of experience scaling tech-enabled consumer and logistics businesses across India. My work spans multi-city marketplace expansion, intercity logistics, product-led operations, and revenue/margin ownership—delivering measurable business impact across Spinny, Rivigo, Shell, and ITC.

Across these roles, I’ve led transformations that include:

Scaling a consumer marketplace to ₹400 Cr+ ARR with 100% growth in 4 months

Driving $30M+ global OPEX savings and $50M working capital optimization

Expanding national logistics networks by 300+ fleet units

Delivering ₹21 Cr+ annual savings through industry-first operational innovation

Owning multi-city P&Ls and optimizing unit economics, pricing, and margins

I operate at the intersection of Product × Operations × GTM, partnering with cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, launch new city models, strengthen unit economics, and identify high-value customer segments (relocation, gifting, premium services, etc.). My leadership style centers on speed, clarity, and data-driven decision-making—turning ambiguity into scalable systems.

What energizes me most is taking businesses from 0→1 and 1→10. I enjoy building high-performance teams, designing ground-up operational frameworks, running rapid growth experiments, and unlocking new market opportunities. Whether in consumer services, logistics, or supply chain environments, I bring a founder-mindset backed by structured execution, commercial depth, and operational excellence.

Always open to conversations around:
P&L leadership • Marketplace & logistics scaling • Intercity growth • Product-led operations • GTM strategy • Unit economics • Strategic partnerships • CX improvement • High-growth execution

If you’re building something challenging and high-velocity, I’d love to connect.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Antaragni is the annual cultural festival of Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, held in the month of October, and is one of the popular college festivals in India. It is a four-day-long festival, attracting participation from over 200 colleges of India. It includes professional shows, competitions, amateur rock bands, Ustads and Pandits, fashion shows, Indian folk dances, and other events. Antaragni has included performances by Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy, Poets of the Fall, Sunidhi Chauhan and Raghu Dixit. The festival also aims to serve as a platform for the expression of youth opinion on social problems. It began as an inter-collegiate cultural event in 1966, and now draws in over 30,000 visitors from 300 colleges in India. Antaragni is a non-profit organisation run completely by students of IIT Kanpur. It started off small, funded entirely by the Student Gymkhana of IIT Kanpur. Today the budget is over ₹1 crore (₹10 million), raised through sponsorship.

basic_profile.name: Vidur Malhotra
basic_profile.headline: Engineering Leader | Leading MidMile & Fleet Management Systems @ Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
12 years of intensive experience in Product conceptualization and Tech development in different domains - Logistics, Healthcare, ecommerce, Telecom, IOT, Saas. I have worked both in early stage startups and enterprise companies. I have expertise in building high performance distributed systems using Agile Principles with strong focus on security and cost optimization.

I am driving adoption of AI tools across development workflows in Delhivery — running pilots and PoCs with tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Codex etc to enhance coding efficiency, productivity, debugging, and documentation.

I am passionate about building systems that scale, simplify operations, and create measurable business impact.

Currently leading engineering for both the MidMile and Fleet Management Systems at Delhivery, driving initiatives that directly impact core logistics operations at scale.

Previously at LocoNav Inc., I led the development of a modern Fleet Management SaaS platform, combining IoT and intelligent analytics to deliver impactful solutions driving product growth through strategic innovation.

In my prevois roles, as a Senior Lead Engineer at Airtel X Labs, I revolutionized the B2B onboarding process, introducing the first fully digital acquisition journey. I built and led a team of 20 engineers, fostering an environment of motivation and ingenuity that significantly improved customer experiences and streamlined operations. Our collective efforts in projects such as UIDAI authentication and eKYC services have been pivotal in enhancing the company's digital infrastructure.

Early member of the technology team at HealthKart, where I contributed to the company’s journey from 0 to 1. I streamlined order processing and inventory management systems, and designed a robust B2B platform from scratch, laying the foundation for scalable growth.

▪    Built cross-functional business infrastructure with Finance, Tax, Legal and Technology teams, establishing processes for reconciliation, revenue recognition, GST, vendor settlements, customer cashback, payment gateway integration, data security and DPDP compliance.
▪    Enabled strategic synergies with Delhivery's core network and digital ecosystem by developing a fleet-owner engagement platform and laying the foundation for FASTag/GPS data-led capabilities across load discovery, capacity sourcing and logistics intelligence products.

Established in 2001, the ISB has successfully put India on the global map of management education by pioneering several new trends in research, promoting innovation and training and nurturing young leaders who not only have an understanding of the developing economies but the society at large. With two state-of-the-art campuses in Hyderabad and Mohali, ISB provides opportunities to engage with the best of global management practice and thinking. In 2008, ISB became the youngest institution to be ranked among the Top 20 Global B-schools by the Financial Times, London, and since then has been ranked consistently among the top B-schools globally. A proficient pool of research-oriented resident and visiting faculty from top management institutions worldwide provides the essential thrust to ISB’s research milieu. ISB’s strong research acumen has helped produce knowledge and competencies to benefit industry and society, not only in India but across Asia and the rest of the world. Around the world, the School is represented by its network of 17,200+ alumni from the PGP and AMP suites, PGP,PGPMAX, PGPpro, PGP MFAB, AMPBA, AMPH, AMPI, AMPOS, and AMPPP, and the 50,000+ alumni of its Executive Education programmes.Whether it is through innovations in curricula to reflect the shifting business landscape or stimulating experiences and learning outside the classroom, the ISB is committed to providing the best avenue for management education and research to meet the growing need to develop young leaders who can manage global challenges.For more information on the School, visit www.isb.edu Follow us:Twitter: www.twitter.com/ISbeduFacebook: https://www.facebook.com/ISBedu/YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/isbindiaInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/isbindia/Blog: https://blogs.isb.edu/

Program management: (May 2015 - September 2015)
Responsible for tracking capacity ramp-up for Large supply chain in order to cater to Big Billion Day 2015.

5. Devised processes for training and development of the vendors to provide value-added services and quality customer experience.

past.employee_description:
Led global mid-mile operations for over 100 oil and by-product consignments, facilitating $2B in trade across 40+ geographies. My role combined high-stakes execution with strategic planning, crisis response, and stakeholder coordination in fast-paced, cross-border environments.

Key Achievements:
	•	Selected (1 of 300) to lead a 15-member external team during a critical five-year maintenance project in Turkey—completed ahead of schedule, saving $150K.
	•	Increased cargo intake by 250 tons (~$100K in revenue) by optimizing loading throughput based on performance curve analysis.
	•	Averted $15M in losses by developing and executing an emergency recovery strategy during a critical navigation incident in Argentina.
	•	Improved port turnaround time by 12%, reducing annual port charges by $200K through bottleneck identification and cross-training of crew.
	•	Accelerated post-merger integration (Synergy acquisition of Maersk) by 60% through SOP redesign and implementation across functions.
	•	Achieved zero deficiencies in international compliance audits, saving $90K in penalties.
	•	Led containment of a major oil spill, mitigating $2.5M in environmental penalties through quick team mobilization and execution.
	•	Reduced emergency response time by 27% by introducing weekly KPI monitoring and updated emergency protocols.
	•	Liaised with global regulatory authorities to streamline 50+ compliance checks and reduced customs clearance time by 30%.
	•	Safeguarded 23 lives and avoided $5M in losses during a piracy threat, and led emergency actions to prevent a potential capsize (impact: $50M avoided).

past.employee_description:
As part of the mid-mile segment of the global supply chain, I was handpicked (4 out of 102 officers) by senior management to lead high-stakes operations for 20+ chemical consignments worth over $500M. My role focused on driving process excellence, cost optimization, and risk mitigation in high-pressure, compliance-heavy environments.

Key Achievements:
	•	Achieved a 10% reduction in procurement costs (~$60K annually) through vendor consolidation and contract renegotiations.
	•	Reduced logistics costs by 9% by optimizing maintenance schedules and batching deliveries.
	•	Lowered F&B costs by 13% by building a demand forecasting model and implementing inventory controls, reducing stockouts by 22%.
	•	Designed a supplier performance dashboard and quarterly evaluation system to identify underperforming vendors.
	•	Revamped fleetwide risk assessment protocols (20+ ships) by factoring in vessel-specific constraints—resulting in improved safety outcomes.

past.employee_description:
After over 7 years of building and scaling systems for the transportation side of logistics, I am now focused on the warehousing side at Delhivery. Combining transportation with warehousing has enabled Delhivery to become India’s largest integrated logistics service provider.  

Currently, my key priorities include:  
1. Reducing Client Onboarding Time: Streamlining processes to cut onboarding timelines from months to weeks.  
2. Optimizing Large Warehouse Operations: Enhancing workflows in facilities as large as 70,000 sq. ft. to deliver superior SLAs to our clients.  
3. Ensuring Inventory Accuracy at Scale: Managing millions of items with precision and ensuring seamless tracking for every unit.  
In addition to warehousing technology, I am also driving initiatives in Generative AI to elevate customer experience. Key focus areas include:  
- Enabling customers to access precise information with minimal support involvement.  
- Structuring knowledge effectively so the support team can deliver accurate and efficient responses.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Gopali Youth Welfare Society (GYWS) is a non-government organization (NGO) run by a team of students and professors of IIT Kharagpur, with assistance from local social enthusiasts. Established in 2002 and registered under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act in 2004, GYWS aims to improve the living standards of the people of Gopali (a village located 5 km from the IIT campus), and tackling social, economic and educational problems faced by the rural communities through its projects and initiatives.One of GYWS's prime projects is Jagriti Vidya Mandir, an English-medium school in Gopali, which aims to provide education to children from underprivileged backgrounds. Established in 2008, the school currently has students studying from Nursery to Class V. Started initially in a leased building, the school has since moved to its own permanent campus, which is planned to be developed into a hostel-cum-school campus with classes up to XII. To financially support our students’ education, GYWS started the 'Educate A Child' scheme under which interested donors can adopt and fund a child’s education, including costs for books, stationery, uniform, transport etc. for an entire academic year. A number of alumni, students and professors of IIT Kharagpur are a part of this initiative. GYWS also has a number of other initiatives in the fields of prevention of child labour, women empowerment, grievance redressal for government activities, health awareness etc.The Society and its activities are mainly supported by donations from alumni,  professors and students of IIT Kharagpur, as well as local industries. All donations to GYWS are exempted from taxes under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act and Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA).Like us on Facebook - http://www.facebook.com/gyws.iitkgp/

My role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—using data, structured problem-solving and cross-functional leadership to build scalable, reliable and cost-efficient logistics operations.

Coffee Day group, one of India’s fastest growing business conglomerates with interests ranging from coffee plantations and agri-businesses, commodity exports, stakeholdings in leading IT and embedded technology companies, real estate and hospitality.While traditionally known for its stevedoring, customs handling, trucking and steamer agency businesses, Sical today has made significant investments in logistics related infrastructure and operates mechanized Port terminals (container and bulk), container freight stations, container rakes, rail and road terminals. The success mantra is based on creating right process, investing in right infrastructure, recruiting and nourishing capability of employees, constant training and exemplary business ethics.

past.employer_linkedin_description: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. Owners and operators of over 157K storefronts use the OYO platform to manage all mission-critical aspects of their business operations. OYO’s comprehensive, full-stack technology suite integrates more than 40 products and services across digital sign-up and onboarding, revenue management, daily business management and D2C stacks into two flagship patron applications, Co-OYO and OYO OS. OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Prione (a JV between Catamaran and Amazon) was established in 2014 with the vision to enable small and medium businesses (SMBs) in India’s fast-growing digital economy, by creation and upliftment of SMB capabilities. We are the world's largest online bus ticketing platform built in India. It’s an exciting journey to constantly dabble with ideas that transform bus travel for millions; the 8 million happy customers we’ve served so far and many more to come. We’re proud to be a part of go-MMT group (NASDAQ: MMYT). redBus has morphed into an Indian multinational with footprint in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Cambodia, Colombia, Peru, and expanding into other geographies.Millions of customers, over 70,000 routes, association with over 3000 reputed bus operators – our ecosystem offers a level of complexity and opportunity that the brightest minds will thrive on. Especially since we are changing the rules of the game. Future technologies drive not just our business, but help thousands of partners in the travel related ecosystem reinvent their service offerings.Ours is a level playing field; ideas can come from anyone. past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

basic_profile.name: Lt Col Anirban  Das
basic_profile.headline: Senior Director – Risk Analysis, Loss Prevention & Business Continuity | Large-Scale Logistics Networks | 23+ Years Army & Corporate Operations | Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
I work at the intersection of supply chain operations, network risk, and operational resilience in large logistics systems.

An Indian Army veteran with over two decades of experience across military logistics and commercial supply chains, I have operated in environments where operational continuity, discipline, and resource optimisation directly influence mission or business outcomes.

Currently, I serve as Senior Director at Delhivery, where I lead risk analysis, loss prevention, and business continuity across critical mid-mile infrastructure supporting high-volume logistics networks.

My work focuses on identifying vulnerabilities within complex operational systems — from process deviations and fraud risks to systemic inefficiencies that quietly translate into operational and financial loss. By strengthening governance, analytics, and control frameworks, I work to improve resilience while sustaining the speed and scale demanded by modern logistics networks.

Across both military and corporate roles, my experience sits at the intersection of operations, risk management, and organisational resilience in large distributed systems.

I occasionally share reflections on supply chain risk, operational resilience, and system design in large logistics networks.

Always open to thoughtful conversations on supply chain operations, risk, and operational resilience.
📩 AnirbanDas.org@outlook.com

past.employer_linkedin_description: One of the most diversified integrated steel producers with a capacity of 36 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) across India, the Netherlands, the UK, and Thailand, Tata Steel is shaping a better tomorrow through innovation, sustainability, and an enduring commitment to excellence. As one of India’s top multiplex chains, INOX operates 730 screens in 171 multiplexes across 74 cities of India. The entertainment venture of the renowned INOX Group, started its journey in 2002 from its 1st multiplex in Bund Gardens Pune, now entertains 70 Mn guests across the country annually. In the process, INOX has set high benchmarks of ‘Luxury’, ‘Service’ & ‘Technology’ in the cinema exhibition industry.Thriving on innovativeness, INOX has pioneered plenty of ‘firsts’ in the industry. INOX operates Megaplex at the Inorbit Mall Malad, Mumbai, a multiplex with highest number of cinema viewing experiences in the world, which is also home to India’s first ScreenX as well as India’s first screen with MX4D® Theater Effects. INOX was the 1st cinema chain in the country to operate a Laserplex, a multiplex with all the screens enabled with Laser Projection. With the grand & immersive IMAX screens already a part of its repertoire, INOX also has to its credit, Mumbai’s first Samsung ONYX LED screen at the Megaplex. INOX’s 7-star cinema viewing experience, INSIGNIA, has emerged as top luxury proposition in the country. INOX’s desire to offer tailor-made experiences to its patrons led to the creation of home-grown formats like the vibrant and lively KIDDLES for the young audience, the smart luxury experience CLUB for the discerning guests and BIGPIX a premium giant screen cinema format.  INOX also maintains a sharp focus on F&B and architectural design to stay ahead on the ‘Experience’ curve. INOX has curated a lot of F&B concepts, cuisines and menu options. INOX’s focus on developing captivating architectural designs make the multiplexes look aspirational and also complete the ‘Experience’ promise. Driven by its passion to improvise unremittingly and deliver moments which may be treasured by patrons, INOX is committed towards operating a sustainable, responsible and profitable business venture and attain new levels of operational brilliance.

Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

Senior Manager of First Mile / Last Mile Business Partner Development (BPD), North Region 

Responsibility 
1. Internal Team Management 
 All North Zone BPD RMs reporting to me whoever directly Handling First Mile / Last Mile Business Partners

-Support in accident or incident investigations involving fleet vehicles.

-Negotiate contract terms, pricing models, and incentives with fleet owners.
-Monitor logistics costs and help optimize delivery costs without sacrificing service quality.

8. Technology & Tools Enablement
-Encourage and support adoption of company tech platforms
-Driver upload POD through Company App
-Driver do SMS Delivery for B2C customers

National Head Vendor Development

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Parachute Regiment (Special Forces) was the brain child of Lt Col Megh Singh who created the "Meghdoot Force" in 1965. This was later merged with "The Parachute Regiment" in 1966 to form the first Commando Battalion  called the 9 Para Commando Battalion and then in 1967, 10 Para Commando Battalion. This was the first time ever Commando Battalion were raised and then in 2001 all Commando Battalions were         re-desginated as Special Forces Battalion due to change in the mandate. Today the Parachute Regiment (Special Forces) is the punch line of the Indian Armed Forces along with other specialised units from the Indian Navy (Marine Commandos) and Indian Air Force (Garuds). The Parachute Regiment Special Forces also contribute to many other specialised units like National Security Guards and Special Group. This is a closed group is dedicated to all those brave souls who have laid down their life for the man standing next to him, his country and to all those who have served in Para (Special Forces) of The Parachute Regiment.

Two chartered accountancy firms S.P. Puri & Co. and S.C. Vasudeva & Co., well-known in the profession, especially in North India have merged to form SCV & Co. LLP with effect from 1st April 2018 which has now been converted into a Limited Liability Partnership.Mr. Puri and Mr. Vasudeva, both qualified as Chartered Accountants in early 1960s. Mr. Puri and Mr. Vasudeva both being contemporaries reorganised and expanded their respective practices in the year 1976 with the same set of core values i.e. Integrity, Quality, Client Care and Trust. While S.P. Puri & Co, specialised in taxation and allied services, S.C. Vasudeva & Co. carved a niche for itself in the field of audit and allied services. Both the firms had humble beginning and have grown over the years in terms of service offerings and client base. The coming together of the firms is with an eye for the future, bringing tremendous synergies in operations and provides a platform to move ahead in this industry.The primary service offerings of SCV & Co. LLP are Assurance, Risk Advisory, Tax Advisory, Corporate Advisory and Outsourcing. Our comprehensive connections with various firms and chartered accountants globally enables us to provide our clients with a unique combination of extensive global resources, world‐recognized expertise and deep local knowledge. We remain committed to the ongoing growth of this global capability in all areas of services.VISION:Shall be a leader in providing high quality services in the field of Audit and Assurance, Accounting, Tax and Business Advisory to domestic and international clients. The firm would have offices in principal cities of India and would develop niche areas for the future growth of the firm.MISSION:To deliver services in a timely manner. To create value for our clients. To maintain our personal relationships with the clients that are the foundation of our practice. To provide an enjoyable learning experience and an opportunity for growth for all.

HT Media Group is among India's largest media and entertainment conglomerates. The Group's offerings spanning Print, Audio, and Digital verticals, have remained crucial and relevant for nearly a century in influencing culture and shaping public opinion. The Group enjoys wide-reaching popularity and has built reliable credibility across its Print brands - English daily Hindustan Times, the Hindi daily Hindustan, and the business publication Mint. It enjoys a prominent presence in the Audio space through much-loved and enjoyed brand offerings, including Fever FM, Radio Nasha, Radio One, FAB Market, HT Smartcast, and Punjabi Fever. The Group also owns popular Internet businesses, including OTT Play, Slurrp, and Healthshots. For more details, visit www.htmedia.in.

past.employer_name: Techkriti, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur
past.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur, established in 1959, is one of the premier institutions established by the Government of India. The aim of the Institute is to nurture young minds and drive forward leadership in technological innovation. Techkriti is the annual international Technical & Entrepreneurship festival of IIT Kanpur organised by the students of IIT Kanpur to realise this aim.Since its founding in 1995, Techkriti has developed into one of Asia's biggest technology festivals. Annually, the event spans four days in March and draws attendees from all across India and overseas, with over 40,000 people attending from both countries.Apart from fierce and neck to neck competitions in various fields, such as Robotics, Electronics, Business, Design, Coding, Aero-modelling, Online events (Crypto, Stocksim etc.). We also have guest lectures and exhibitions to inspire the students to take that extra step towards innovation.Late Dr. A. P.J. Abdul Kalam, the former president of India and the man behind the country's missile program; Dr. Hamid Karzai, the former honourable president of Afghanistan; Vladimir Voevodsky, the Russian field medalist; Douglas Osheroff, the Nobel Laureate in Physics; Michael Foreman, the NASA astronaut; Marshall Strabala, the architect of Burj Khalifa; Prof. Henry Schaffer III, the winner of the Peter Debye Award in the United States;Walter Lewin, the astrophysicist at MIT; Rakesh Sharma, the Indian astronaut; Alvin E. Roth, the Nobel Laureate in Economics; and many more have graced the students and academic community in the past. With its 31st edition, Techkriti is poised to stimulate innovation and eradicate social problems through social campaigns in this century of technocrats and entrepreneurs.For a more detailed description, visit https://techkriti.org or log on tohttps://www.instagram.com/techkriti.iitk/https://www.facebook.com/techkriti.iitkhttps://www.youtube.com/@TechkritiIITKanpurhttps://x.com/techkriti_iitk

past.employer_linkedin_description: Our story began in 1990 as a small courier delivery service company with big ambitions and bigger dreams. Our vision was to not just build a business, but to build enduring and close ties with our customers, while offering them a broad range of services. 25 years later, and over 10K locations across the globe, DTDC Express Limited has grown from your next-door courier shop to a multinational logistics company. As strategic partners of DPD, owned by the international brand GeoPost, our story has reached a new chapter as India’s largest parcel delivery network.In 2000, we made our first step towards building our name as a truly international logistics company. Through subsidiaries and joint ventures, today we have direct international presence in over 22 countries including Singapore, U.S., UK, Canada, UAE, China, & Australia. We operate through our associates in Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, Nepal, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Kenya, Myanmar, Thailand & Iran. Apart from this, we’ve expanded our end-to-end solutions services outside India, to South-East Asia, Middle East, and Far-East region of the globe.DTDC is a one-stop store for all e-tail services, offering tailor-made solutions like marketplace listing, multi-vendor management, tech development, warehousing & fulfilment, cross-border solutions, last-mile delivery, reverse logistics management, and more. Be it start-ups or established players, our fulfilment warehouses are designed to facilitate smooth order-fulfilment processes, from receiving to product delivery. Our best-in-class warehouse management systems are tailored to efficiently ship thousands of orders of any size.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Make A Difference (MAD) is one of India's largest millennial-driven, non-profit organizations working to transform outcomes for children in need of care and protection.MAD's Vision is that all children that grow up in care in India are able to realize equitable outcomes on par with the middle class.MAD’s Mission is to ensure that all children in shelters across India are able to realize equitable outcomes within the next 25 years, by mobilizing the community, empowering the child, enabling the sector, and changing the ecosystem. We are building new holistic, integrated, and long-term developmental methodologies that enable us to work with children in an age-transitional way, all the way from young childhood into adulthood, from age 10 to 28.As of today Make a Difference works with approximately 3500 children in partnership with 60 shelters across 23 cities in India, through a highly efficient and unique operating model that is almost entirely volunteer-driven with an overall workforce size of 4000 in flat, distributed structure that runs on virtual infrastructure. We operate at less than 1/10th the cost of an equivalent sized non-profit, with no loss in continuity, retention or quality, and are pioneers in both culture and organisational design that is specialized for impact. Make A Difference consistently ranks in the Top 10 Best NGOs to Work For in India, and most recently ranked in India's Top 10 Great Mid-size Workplaces across all sectors in the Great Place To Work Institute's 2018 Survey.

Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

Established in 1964, BHEL is one of India's largest engineering and manufacturing enterprises in the energy and infrastructure sectors, and a leading power equipment manufacturer globally. BHEL serves the core sectors of the economy and provides a comprehensive portfolio of products, systems and services to customers in power, transmission, transportation, renewables, water, defence & aerospace, oil & gas, and industry. BHEL has created value for its stakeholders due to the scale and depth of its operations, rich experience, competent manpower, innovative ecosystem, diverse product-mix and focus on sustainable business solutions. BHEL’s greatest asset- its highly skilled and committed workforce of more than 34,000 employees is the cornerstone of its success.BHEL’s commitment to nation building reflects in many ways- in its contribution to the country’s installed power generation capacity; bringing the latest state-of-the-art technology to the country; consistent highest expenditure of more than 2.5% of its turnover on R&D and innovation in the Indian engineering segment; pan-India presence; establishment of world-class assets with presence in over 84 country across the globe, and contribution to the society at large through initiatives in skilling youth, health & hygiene, education, cleanliness and environment protection, to name a few.With a widespread network of 16 manufacturing facilities, 2 repair units, 4 regional offices, 8 service centres, 1 subsidiary, 3 active joint ventures, 15 regional marketing centres, 3 overseas offices and current project execution at more than 150 project sites across India and abroad, BHEL manufactures a wide range of high quality & reliable products adhering to national & international standards. BHEL has installed over 1000 utility sets worldwide with its installed base of supplied power generating equipment exceeding 185 GW. BHEL has also commissioned 200+ electric substations & 5 major HVDC projects in the country.

Ola is India’s largest mobility platform and one of the world’s largest ride-hailing companies, serving 250+ cities across India. The Ola app offers mobility solutions by connecting customers to drivers and a wide range of vehicles across bikes, auto-rickshaws, metered taxis, and cabs, enabling convenience and transparency for hundreds of millions of consumers and over 1.5 million driver-partners.Ola’s core mobility offering in India is supplemented by its electric-vehicle arm, Ola Electric; India’s largest fleet management business, Ola Fleet Technologies and Ola Skilling, that aims to enable millions of livelihood opportunities for India's youth. With its acquisition of Ridlr, India’s leading public transportation app and investment in Vogo, a dockless scooter sharing solution, Ola is looking to build mobility for the next billion Indians. Ola also extends its consumer offerings like micro-insurance and credit led payments through Ola Financial Services and a range of owned food brands through India’s largest network of kitchens under its Food business. Ola was founded in 2010 by Bhavish Aggarwal and Ankit Bhati with a mission to build mobility for a billion people. For more details, visit www.olacabs.com/media

basic_profile.name: Gourav Kumar Pandey
basic_profile.headline: Senior Director OPS
basic_profile.summary: As a senior operations leader with over 10 years of experience in e-commerce and logistics, I have built and led large-scale supply chain operations across Amazon, Blinkit, and Delhivery. My expertise spans fulfillment center operations, hub operations, last-mile logistics, network optimization, operational excellence, and organizational leadership.Throughout my career, I have successfully scaled complex, high-volume operations by combining strategic planning with disciplined execution. I have led cross-functional teams, driven operational transformation, and consistently delivered improvements in productivity, cost efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.Currently, I serve as Senior Director – Hub Operations (Uttar Pradesh) at Delhivery, where I lead one of the company's largest regional hub networks. I oversee operations across 10+ hubs, managing a daily throughput of 400,000+ shipments while leading a workforce of 1,500+ off-roll associates and 40+ on-roll leaders (Managers and above). My responsibilities include network performance, capacity planning, cost optimization, operational strategy, stakeholder management, and leadership development to ensure scalable and sustainable business growth.Previously, I spent 8 years at Amazon, leading fulfillment center and last-mile operations, where I developed deep expertise in Lean operations, process excellence, and customer-centric execution. I also served as Fulfillment Center Operations Head at Blinkit, driving warehouse performance and operational scalability in the fast-paced quick-commerce ecosystem.My leadership philosophy is centered on building high-performing teams, developing future leaders, and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. I enjoy solving complex operational challenges, leveraging data to drive strategic decisions, and delivering measurable business outcomes that create long-term value.I am always open to connecting with leaders and organizations that are shaping the future of supply chain, logistics, and operations through innovation, technology, and operational excellence.

basic_profile.name: Sangameshwar Neela
basic_profile.headline: Director of Operations @ Delhivery | MBA, Operations Management
basic_profile.summary:
With 14 years of experience in various aspects of operations, I am currently the Director of Operations - GW at Delhivery, India's leading logistics and supply chain services company. My role involves overseeing the ground operations, quality, and performance of the fulfillment centers, warehouses, and transportation hubs across the State.

I have a strong background in operations management, lean manufacturing, kaizen, and six sigma, which I acquired and applied in my previous roles at Amazon and Mahindra & Mahindra Automotive. I have successfully managed and improved the outbound operations, logistics, and supply chain operations for Amazon in India and the UK, as well as the vehicle assembly operations, in-process quality, industrial engineering, and process engineering for Mahindra & Mahindra. I have also demonstrated my skills in FMEA, automotive engineering, ISO/TS 16949, APQP, and manufacturing, which are essential for ensuring quality and efficiency in the operations domain.

My mission is to leverage my expertise and experience to optimize the operations and processes of Delhivery, and to deliver exceptional service and value to our customers and partners. I am passionate about innovation, excellence, and teamwork, and I strive to create a culture of continuous improvement and learning in my organization.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Jumbotail is India's leading B2B marketplace and New Retail platform, serving thousands of mom & pop stores (“Kiranas”). Jumbotail ecosystem has 4 in-house, proprietary platforms - B2B online marketplace, Supply Chain & Logistics, Fintech for SME Lending, and Retail platform that powers its J24 branded convenience grocery stores. Jumbotail transforms traditional unorganised kirana stores into J24 branded modern convenience grocery stores, owned and operated by kirana entrepreneurs, powered by Jumbotail's New Retail platform and playbook consisting of J24 consumer branding, in-store GoldenEye retail technology, data driven product selection and merchandising insights, integrated supply chain with daily store fulfilments, Greencard loyalty program and payment solutions.Our vision is to organise the food and grocery ecosystem in India using technology, data science and design. We are building products, platforms and services for the next billion people of India, who have fundamentally different needs - access, language, selection, supply chain, financial, cultural, and the like. Our market potential is huge - in the order of hundreds of billions of dollars. We are reimagining and reengineering the food and grocery ecosystem through intelligent technology, intuitive design, and innovative business and supply chain models. We are a passionate team driven by our sense of purpose to solve a critical real world problem. Each team member will have significant ownership of key components that go into the next generation e-commerce, supply chain, demand generation, and credit technology platforms and services that we are building. The work you will do at Jumbotail will impact real lives and bring a lasting positive change for the next billion people of India. We promise a fun, fast paced ride with some of the smartest people, with full of opportunities to learn and grow, and leave a legacy. Come join us, make your one life count! Write to us at mission@jumbotail.com

basic_profile.summary:
A result-driven logistics professional with a proven track record in driving operational excellence and strategic innovations within the supply chain industry. 
With extensive experience in Operations Management, I am currently leading the operations of Regional Hubs and Fulfillment Centres of Pune region, driving margin improvement, process optimization, cost saving initiatives across the business units.

In my stint as a Senior Manager – Central Supply Chain at ElasticRun, I have successfully led transformative initiatives, optimizing procurement and supply chain operations across PAN India locations. My expertise lies in efficient supply chain management, operational excellence, financial optimization, vendor negotiation, and strategic partnership development.

During my impactful tenure at Mahindra Logistics Ltd., I orchestrated a revolutionary transformation in the logistics landscape. I led a 27-member team, optimizing nationwide tractor transportation and setting new industry standards. My achievements include pioneering innovative logistics solutions, reducing operational costs, and spearheading market expansion initiatives.

I hold an MBA in Operations Management from Welingkar Institute of Management Development and Research and a B.E. in Chemical Engineering from Bharati Vidyapeeth College of Engineering. My commitment to continuous growth is reflected in accolades such as the Star Team of the Year Award, Mahindra Yellow Belt, and the Harvard Manage Mentor Certificate.

I am passionate about driving efficiencies, fostering strategic partnerships, and implementing cutting-edge solutions in the logistics domain. Let's connect to explore opportunities for collaboration and discuss how my expertise can contribute to your organization's success.

past.employee_description:
Led a 27-member team and revolutionized the logistics sector. We optimized nationwide tractor transportation via road and rail, significantly enhancing our supply chain efficiency and setting new industry standards.

I took vendor optimization to a whole new level, forging game-changing relationships and executing precision strategies to elevate our dispatch capacity. This proactive approach not only supercharged our logistics performance but also kindled a profound sense of client satisfaction, solidifying our position as an industry leader.

Led the Shadow Board Project, transforming Auto/Car Carriers distribution. Optimized routes, raising gross margin from 18% to 27%. Implemented Oracle Transport Management for seamless tractor outbound transportation, overseeing a vast fleet.

Exceeded revenue targets at Nagpur Stockyard by 13%, saving INR 75 lakhs over two years. Reduced rework per hundred (RPH) in primary transportation to unmatched levels. During the lockdown, safely guided INR 50 crore inventory in 2 months, showcasing exceptional stakeholder management and seamless logistics operation.

My innovative spirit extended to pioneering projects in reverse logistics, unlocking annual savings of INR 2 Cr. Simultaneously, I launched fleet management initiatives that opened green channels, maximized vehicle utilization, and unleashed a torrent of innovative logistics solutions, ushering in substantial cost savings.

Executed a monumental reduction in rework per hundred (RPH) from a staggering 12.3% to a mere 0.34%. My strategic use of tools like Pareto, Fishbone, and PFD delivered results. I streamlined storage processes, slashing costs from INR 1.78 Cr to 1.31 Cr, while reducing loading turnaround time from 45 minutes to an astonishing 20 minutes.

My entrepreneurship secured Eicher Tractors' transportation business. I managed independent operations, directing dispatch via trains to Bangladesh. This strategy boosted revenue, margin and successful market expansion

past.employer_linkedin_description: One of the most diversified integrated steel producers with a capacity of 36 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) across India, the Netherlands, the UK, and Thailand, Tata Steel is shaping a better tomorrow through innovation, sustainability, and an enduring commitment to excellence. The Company’s Jamshedpur, Kalinganagar and IJmuiden plants have been recognised among the World Economic Forum Advanced 4th Industrial Revolution (4IR) Global Lighthouses. With over 77,000 employees across the globe, Tata Steel is a Great Place to Work®-certified organisation. The Company recorded a consolidated turnover of approximately US$26 billion in the financial year ending March 31, 2026.Tata Steel has set an ambitious target of achieving Net Zero emissions by 2045. The newly inaugurated 0.75 MTPA electric arc furnace-based steelmaking facility in Ludhiana is the Company’s first low-emission plant in India. In the UK, Tata Steel is transitioning to a 3.2 MTPA EAF-based steelmaking route while in the Netherlands, the Company has signed a non-binding Joint Letter of Intent with the Government of the Netherlands and the Province of North-Holland on integrated decarbonisation and health measures project.Focused on sustainability, innovation, agility, and fostering deep relationships with customers and communities, Tata Steel aspires to become the most respected and valuable metals and mining company globally.

basic_profile.headline: Vice President at Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
In an experience of more than 27years, I have achieved success in building profitable organizations, delivering competitive edge for revenue growth in start-up, mature and turnaround environments, strengthening operational excellence, and setting up scalable infrastructure from scratch for sales, marketing and distribution channels. 

I have headed large-scale business operations, developed and launched pioneering products, improved brand value, achieved leadership position in market share, driven growth to generate annual turnover in excess of INR 4500 crore (USD 60+ million), and increased margins in highly competitive markets.

Colleagues and business partners acknowledge me as an inspirational leader, value creator and business strategist, adept at adjusting quickly to challenges, leveraging business opportunities, and dealing effectively with key stakeholders.

Highlights:

At Aircel, I developed and led high-performing teams of up to 1000 people, established efficient technical, operational and manpower capabilities, built new business and distribution networks from the ground up, and turned around operations from EBITDA loss of INR 400 crore to EBITDA profit of INR 100+ crore within 2 years. At present I am heading the Wireless Business for West Region Circle.
While with Vodafone, I doubled the top line in one year, achieved market leadership position, and increased the subscriber base by penetrating new markets.

Specialities: 

P&L Management | Business Planning | Business Development | Go-to-market | Brand & Product Portfolio Management | Channel Partner Management | Budget & Margin Management | Post-M&A Integration | Team Building

Zenergize Power Tech Private Limited is an indigenous Indian manufacturer of Silicon Carbide (SiC) solar inverters and EV charging equipment, designed from the ground up for India’s heat, grid instability, and regulatory requirements. Our solar inverters use Infineon SiC technology - operating at 97–98% efficiency and maintaining full output at 55°C, where conventional IGBT inverters lose 10–15% capacity. All inverters are BIS IS 16221 certified, making them fully eligible for PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidies. Product range: grid-tied solar inverters (5kW, 8kW, 15kW), residential and commercial AC EV chargers (3.3–22kW), and DC fast chargers (30–240kW). All products connect to ZenSense - our proprietary solar + EV monitoring app. Founded by IIT engineers. Manufactured in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh. PAN-India installation and service across 40+ cities.

Delhivery is India’s only end-to-end e-commerce enablement business with a vision to create outstanding consumer experiences by enabling sellers and consumers to connect faster.

Today, Delhivery provides an array of products and services for online businesses - including online channel integration services, sourcing, catalogue management, inventory management, multi-city fulfillment, express shipping, same day delivery services, reverse logistics, offline payment collection and processing, customer support, social media engagement and channel analytics.

We work with e-retailers, merchants and offline retailers across the country.
Our operational capabilities are designed to meet the needs of any business looking to go online. We provide sellers a modular suite of e-commerce technologies coupled with pan-India logistics operations, helping them achieve fast, reliable and flexible customer fulfillment.

Our proprietary commerce technologies toolkit provides sellers a way to develop and manage their entire online channel - including setting up a web-store and order management system, catalogue management, studio services, integration with marketplaces, managing payments, SEO/SEM, selling on social media platforms, user verification and fraud detection, inventory management. All our IT is built in-house and is completely customized to the unique needs of each of our clients

It is seated in New Delhi, the capital of India.The government comprises three branches: the executive, the legislative and the judiciary. The executive branch headed by the President, who is the Head of State and exercises his or her power directly or through officers subordinate to him.[1] The Legislative branch or the Parliament consists of the lower house, the Lok Sabha, and the upper house, the Rajya Sabha, as well as the president. The union and individual state governments consist of executive, legislative and judicial branches. The legal system as applicable to the federal and individual state governments is based on the English Common and Statutory Law. India accepts International Court of Justice jurisdiction with several reservations.

past.employee_title: Head - Logistics Compliance and Corporate Affairs
past.employee_description:
Led compliance and corporate affairs team for Amazon logistics. Spearheaded engagement with multiple state governments in India for business continuity situations due to the rapidly changing tax and entry tax laws. Product managed the Amazon technology solution to automate the compliance requirements for movement of shipment across states in India.

1. Heading the regulatory operations at a country level and ensuring 100% compliance towards laws with smooth movement across the borders of states. Appointed a team of ~10 consultants to manage all the line haul movement across all modes.

One of the founding members of the Amazon Logistics, India launch team handling multiple projects/roles across network design, product, operations, channel development, corporate affairs, procurement, new initiatives at national and zonal levels. In the last assignment at Amazon, I was heading the regional operations including channel development for alternate deliveries for north last mile operations. 

1. Led a diverse team, that manages an assorted network of forward and reverse mile operations. Network handled ~2L shipments per day with 70+ hubs and 3.5k manpower. It involved handling the entire P&L. 
2. Built a high-performance team that delivered consistently for three years (2015-2017), on exponentially increasing complexity of e-commerce deliveries. 
3. Scaled the variable delivery channel (like I Have Space, Service Partner etc.) to support 10X growth in delivery operations. Optimising cost by ~40% while maintaining service levels of the network. 
4. Channel Development of I Have Space stores from ~500 to 3500 stores in a span of 8 months leading to their contribution shooting to ~65% from 15%. 
5. Design of two futuristic products to scale delivery operations for year 2020 plan. Operating design for both models has been stress tested and one of the models is part of a worldwide product. Estimated saving of ~ $200 MM in India operations. 
6. Build a lean work force engagement model for capacity optimisation in the last mile for managing the peak volumes). Achieved 35% improvement in the capacity utilisation.
